svg.title: How much glutathione is in an ejaculate, compared with the body
svg.desc: Jabbit estimate on a log scale: about 0.065 milligrams of glutathione in one ejaculate, using generous assumptions, compared with 250 milligrams in one supplement capsule, about 1,150 milligrams made in the blood each day and about 1,750 milligrams held in the blood. An ejaculate is roughly 1/18,000 of one day of blood production alone.
